summary: linux-gate can be signed on a host: st-test runs the four stages a linux-gate skip covers (tests, clippy, fleet-compat, mail-redelivery-canaries) through scripts/ci-local as a heavy check, after preparing what CI's test-build job prepares; the lane and the host and agent levels (lane-bound, pull requests only) admit its notes.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

schema.detail: A new lane entry and by_level entries in existing files.

rules.detail: A host- or agent-signed linux-gate note counts on pull requests when signed against the base's lane definition; the check stays in shadow (enforce false) until its own flip. The merge queue runs every stage.

compatibility.detail: st-test's default selection and the pre-push hook are unchanged; ci-local keeps the dev shell's OTELITE collector variables, which its scrub had dropped.

manual.detail: None: a host signs it with its existing key (scripts/st-test --check linux-gate --push origin).

recovery.detail: Remove the by_level entries; nothing else depends on them.
